# technitium_settings_cache (Resource)

Manages the resolver cache.

This is a singleton: declare it once. Attributes left unset follow the server's current value. Destroying the resource only removes it from state; server settings are not reset.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `enable_prefetch` (Boolean) Prefetch popular records before they expire.
- `failure_record_ttl` (Number) TTL for resolution failures.
- `maximum_entries` (Number) Maximum cache entries.
- `maximum_record_ttl` (Number) Maximum TTL applied to cached records.
- `minimum_record_ttl` (Number) Minimum TTL applied to cached records.
- `negative_record_ttl` (Number) TTL for negative answers.
- `prefetch_eligibility` (Number) Hits per hour needed for prefetch.
- `prefetch_sample_eligibility_hits_per_hour` (Number) Technitium 14 only: hits per hour for prefetch sampling.
- `prefetch_sample_interval_minutes` (Number) Technitium 14 only: prefetch sampling interval in minutes.
- `prefetch_trigger` (Number) Remaining TTL in seconds that triggers prefetch.
- `save_cache` (Boolean) Persist the cache across restarts.
- `serve_stale` (Boolean) Serve expired records when upstreams fail (RFC 8767).
- `serve_stale_answer_ttl` (Number) TTL used in stale answers.
- `serve_stale_max_wait_time` (Number) Milliseconds to wait for a fresh answer before serving stale.
- `serve_stale_reset_ttl` (Number) TTL reset applied to stale records after an answer.
- `serve_stale_ttl` (Number) Seconds stale records are kept.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Always `settings`.
